warranty.notes: 70% of system energy at 10 years or the Minimum Throughput Energy, whichever comes first. 20 MWh per 6.14 kWh module. Throughput is the battery's total output (discharged) energy recorded by its control module, from the warranty start date (the earlier of installation or six months after production).

notes: Low-voltage wall/floor module, 6.14 kWh, up to 32 in parallel (196 kWh). The AU brochure gives 6.14 kWh usable (other regions: 5.53 kWh at 90% depth of discharge).
